summary: Iteration 6 verifies REMOVAL of standalone category-budget feature and the NEW pot-driven monthly budget view on the dashboard, incl. over-budget banner/badge behavior and AI regression. All 7 pytest tests PASS and full frontend E2E flow (login → Settings → Dashboard → force over-budget → alert banner + red 'Boven budget' tile → cleanup → alert disappears) PASSED.

minor.issue: Legacy 'category_budgets' key ({'Boodschappen': 400, 'Energie': 250}) is still stored on the demo household from previous iterations and is returned by GET /households/{hid}. PATCH now correctly IGNORES incoming category_budgets (verified), but the stale DB field is never unset. Dashboard response does NOT expose it (spec compliant). Recommend: in startup/seed migration or update_household, add {'$unset': {'category_budgets': ''}} to purge stale data.

backend_verification.test_patch_ignores_category_budgets: PASS (PATCH body {'category_budgets': {'__TEST__':999}} not persisted, existing legacy value unchanged)
backend_verification.test_dashboard_no_category_budgets_key: PASS (dashboard has no 'category_budgets'; still returns months(12), annual, per_person_year, expense_by_category, category_items, current_month, current_month_label)
backend_verification.test_pots_summary_shape: PASS (each pot has pot_id, name, monthly_amount, spent_month, balance, categories)
backend_verification.test_over_budget_flow: PASS (created variable-expense of monthly+500 in current_month → spent_month > monthly; DELETE restores baseline)
backend_verification.test_ai_chat: PASS (200; Dutch reply about potjes returned)

frontend_verification.settings_page_category_budget_removed: PASS (data-testid 'category-budget-card' and 'save-budgets-btn' absent; 'save-settings-btn' present and works)
frontend_verification.dashboard_pots_block: PASS (dashboard-pots-block renders 4 pot tiles: Boodschappen extra, Etentjes & uitjes, Kleding, Vervoer; each shows name, 'Deze maand: €X van €1.199', %-badge, progress bar, 'Saldo (rolt door)')
frontend_verification.over_budget_ui: PASS: after POST variable-expense (Boodschappen €1.699 in 2026-09) — top banner 'budget-alert-banner' shows '1 potje(s) boven het maandbedrag deze maand'; pot tile shows red 'Boven budget' badge and 'Deze maand: €1.699 van €1.199'; progress bar red at 100%. After DELETE, banner disappears and tile returns to '€0 van €1.199 / 0%'.
frontend_verification.months_table: PASS (September row updated to variable €1.699 and Vrij na potjes -€2.375 during overspend; reverted after cleanup)

action_items: (Minor) Unset stale 'category_budgets' field on the demo household document during startup migration or in update_household. Dashboard is unaffected, but GET /households/{hid} still leaks the legacy key.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_household correctly whitelists only (name, split_rule, dashboard_year, quote_statuses) — good.
calc.compute_dashboard no longer emits 'category_budgets' and 'cur_month_cat' — clean.
_ai_context now describes potjes as 'budget = maandbedrag' with clear OVER BUDGET marker — provides Claude with the right framing.
Dashboard.jsx overCount uses tolerance (+0.005) to avoid floating-point false positives — good.
Consider one-shot DB migration on startup to drop legacy 'category_budgets' from households collection (cosmetic).
seed_data_creation: None persisted; all created TEST variable-expenses were deleted (backend + frontend flows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo household 'Huize Constantine' has 4 pots each monthly_amount=1199 linked to categories Boodschappen/Uit eten/Kleding/Vervoer. Dashboard year=2026, current_month evaluated server-side as 9 (Sep) in this run. Over-budget assertion tolerance is +0.005. To force an over-budget scenario deterministically, POST /api/households/{hid}/variable-expenses with month=`${year}-${zeroPad(current_month)}` matching backend, not local clock. DB still has stale 'category_budgets' key on demo household (not exposed by dashboard).
